name: 19342 · Glen Mills, PA
findings: ZIP 19342 (Glen Mills) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19342 (Glen Mills) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19342 (Glen Mills) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).
